applying: Applying… a new size takes longer the first time
build_hint: A folder of PNGs. It is read and shown below before anything is written. Add spec.json to set hotspots, animation frames and delays.
drift: Not every app uses the same cursor. Apply a theme to bring them back in line.
engine_missing: The cursor engine did not run. Check that python3 is installed.
engine_timeout: The cursor engine took longer than a minute and was stopped. Try fewer sizes in the plugin settings, then run it again.
import_hint: A Windows cursor pack folder. It is read and shown below before anything is written. An Install.inf is used when present.
map_source_files: Files in this folder — drag one onto a role, or pick a role then a file
needs_arrow: No arrow cursor was found — assign one below, then convert again.
install_hint: A folder holding a cursors/ directory. Windows packs go in the Import tab.
none_removable: Nothing installed yet — system themes cannot be removed here.
not_a_folder: Build needs a folder of PNGs, not a file.
picker_missing: zenity is not installed — type the path instead, or install zenity.
role_help: Help select — arrow with a question mark
role_size_ns: Resize up/down ↕ — top or bottom edge
role_size_ew: Resize left/right ↔ — left or right edge
role_wait: Busy — hourglass or spinner, the app is not responding
role_working: Working in background — arrow with a spinner
shadow_tooltip: Bake in the drop shadow Windows draws for you
title: Cursor
unmapped_hint: Assign them in the grid below, or rename the file after its role and convert again.
reset_explain: Removes everything this plugin set — compositor, GTK, Qt, Flatpak and login settings — and goes back to the system cursor. Your installed themes stay. This also happens when you remove the plugin.

engine_path.label: Engine path
engine_path.description: Leave empty. Only for a checkout that keeps curmgr elsewhere.

build_sizes.label: Built sizes
build_sizes.description: Nominal sizes baked into themes you import or build.

scale_filter.label: Resampling
scale_filter.description: How cursors are resized. Point keeps pixel art crisp; Lanczos suits smooth artwork.

icon_dirs.label: Extra theme folders
icon_dirs.description: Also look for cursor themes here. ~/.local/share/icons, ~/.icons, $XCURSOR_PATH and $XDG_DATA_DIRS are always searched.

install_dir.label: Install folder
install_dir.description: Where imported, built and installed themes go, and the only folder Remove deletes from. Must be inside your home folder. Anywhere but the default, apps find it through XCURSOR_PATH after the next login. Leave empty for ~/.local/share/icons.

niri_config.label: niri config
niri_config.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/niri/config.kdl. cursor.kdl is written beside it.

hyprland_config.label: Hyprland config
hyprland_config.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf. cursor.conf is written beside it.

sway_config.label: Sway config
sway_config.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/sway/config. cursor.conf is written beside it.

mango_config.label: MangoWC config
mango_config.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/mango/config.conf. cursor.conf is written beside it.

umbriel_config.label: Umbriel config
umbriel_config.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/umbriel/config.toml. cursor.toml is written beside it.
